scheme_name: PM Kisan Maan Dhan Yojana (PM-KMY) Pension for Farmers
overview: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana (PM-KMY) is a voluntary and contributory pension scheme launched by the Government of India for old age protection and social security of Small and Marginal Farmers (SMFs). It provides an assured monthly pension of Rs. 3000/- after attaining the age of 60 years, with matching contributions from the government. The scheme is administered through Common Service Centres (CSCs) and managed by Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC) as the pension fund manager.
objectives: Provide old age protection and social security to Small and Marginal Farmers
Ensure a minimum assured pension of Rs. 3000/- per month after attaining the age of 60 years
Offer family pension benefits to the spouse of the subscriber
Provide pension benefits in case of permanent disability before age 60
Allow exit options with return of contributions and interest under specified conditions
Enable contributions through PM-KISAN benefits or other bank accounts
Ensure zero administrative cost to subscribers
Facilitate enrollment through Common Service Centres (CSCs) or State Nodal Officers (SNOs)
eligibility: All Small and Marginal Farmers having cultivable landholding up to 2 hectares falling in the age group of 18 to 40 years, whose names appear in the land records of States/UTs as on 01.08.2019 are eligible. However, the following are ineligible: SMFs covered under any other statutory social security schemes such as National Pension Scheme (NPS), Employees’ State Insurance Corporation scheme, Employees’ Provident Fund Organization Scheme; farmers who have opted for Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maandhan Yojana or Pradhan Mantri Vyapari Maandhan Yojana; institutional land holders; former and present holders of constitutional posts; former and present Ministers/State Ministers and former/present Members of Lok Sabha/Rajya Sabha/State Legislative Assemblies/State Legislative Councils; former and present Mayors of Municipal Corporations and Chairpersons of District Panchayats; all serving or retired officers and employees of Central/State Government Ministries/Offices/Departments and their field units, Central or State PSEs and Attached offices/Autonomous Institutions under Government as well as regular employees of Local Bodies (excluding Multi Tasking Staff/Class IV/Group D employees); all persons who paid Income Tax in the last assessment year; and professionals like Doctors, Engineers, Lawyers, Chartered Accountants, and Architects registered with professional bodies and carrying out profession by undertaking practice.
benefits: Assured pension of Rs. 3000/- per month after attaining the age of 60 years; family pension of 50% of the pension to the spouse upon death of the subscriber; pension continuation option for spouse in case of death before age 60; return of subscriber's contribution with interest (savings bank rate or actual fund earnings, whichever is higher) on exit before age 60 under specified conditions; transfer of corpus back to the fund after death of subscriber and spouse; no administrative cost to subscribers; nomination facility available; option to contribute via PM-KISAN benefits; pension card issued upon enrollment.
financial_support: The scheme is a voluntary and contributory pension scheme where subscribers make monthly contributions ranging between Rs 55 to Rs 200 per month based on entry age (18 to 40 years) till they attain the age of 60. The Government of India provides a matching contribution equal to the subscriber's monthly contribution. The total monthly contribution (subscriber + government) ranges from Rs 110 to Rs 400. Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC) acts as the Pension Fund Manager responsible for pension pay-out and fund management.
application_process: Step 1: The Eligible SMFs desirous of joining the scheme shall visit nearest Common Service Centre (CSC). Step 2: Following are the prerequisites for the enrolment process: Aadhaar Card Savings Bank Account Number along with IFSC Code ( Bank Passbook or Cheque Leave/book or copy of bank statement as evidence of bank account ). Step 3: Initial contribution amount in cash will be made to the Village Level Entrepreneur (VLE). Step 4: The VLE will key-in the Aadhaar number, Name of subscriber and Date of birth as printed on aadhaar card for authentication. Step 5: The VLE will complete the online registration by filling up the details like Bank Account details, Mobile Number, Email Address, Spouse (if any) and Nominee details will be captured. Step 6: System will auto calculate monthly contribution payable according to age of the Subscriber. Step 7: Subscriber will pay the 1st subscription amount in cash to the VLE. Step 8: Enrolment cum Auto Debit mandate form will be printed and will be further signed by the subscriber. VLE will scan the same and upload it into the system. Step 9: A unique Kisan Pension Account Number (KPAN) will be generated and Kisan Card will be printed.
required_documents: Bank Passbook or Cheque Leave/book or copy of bank statement as evidence of bank account
implementing_agency: Department of Agriculture, Cooperation and Farmers Welfare
caveats: Should not be SMFs covered under any other statutory social security schemes such as National Pension Scheme (NPS), Employees’ State Insurance Corporation scheme, Employees’ Provident Fund Organization Scheme etc.
Farmers who have opted for Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maandhan Yojana and Pradhan Mantri Vyapari Maandhan administered by the Ministry of Labour & Employment are not eligible.

All Institutional Land holders, former and present holders of constitutional posts, former and present Ministers/State Ministers and former/present Members of Lok Sabha/Rajya Sabha/State Legislative Assemblies/State Legislative Councils, former and present Mayors of Municipal Corporations, former and present Chairpersons of District Panchayats are not eligible.

All serving or retired officers and employees of Central/State Government Ministries/Offices/Departments and their field units, Central or State PSEs and Attached offices/Autonomous Institutions under Government as well as regular employees of the Local Bodies (Excluding Multi Tasking Staff / Class IV/Group D employees) are not eligible.
All Persons who paid Income Tax in last assessment year are not eligible.
Professionals like Doctors, Engineers, Lawyers, Chartered Accountants, and Architects registered with Professional bodies and carrying out profession by undertaking practice are not eligible.
In case of incorrect declaration, the beneficiary shall be liable to get back his contributions without any interest thereon and the Central Government’s matching contribution will be stopped.
Land holding is the criteria to be eligible to get the benefit under the scheme; individuals without land holding in their name are not eligible.
Any individual farmer owning more than 2 hectare of cultivable land will not be eligible to get benefit under the scheme.
